chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali al-Shalmaghani narrated in the book of Al-Awsiya, saying: Hamza ibn Nasr, the slave of Abul Hasan (peace be upon him), narrated to me from his father, saying:

When the Master (peace be upon him) was born, the people of the house rejoiced with that news. When he grew up, the order came to me to buy, every day along with the meat, a bone with marrow, and it was said: 'This is for our young Master (peace be upon him).'
ai.seo_question: What was the daily practice regarding food for the young Imam al-Mahdi upon his birth?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the divine preparation of Imam al-Mahdi (aj) from infancy, where the daily provision of meat with marrow (*qasb makhh*) symbolizes both his physical sustenance and elevated spiritual status. The specific detail of purchasing this delicacy daily underscores the continuous divine care and the distinct honor accorded to the Master of the Age even during his hidden childhood years.
